body: "def get_model_info(model_name: str) -> LLMModel | None:
    """Get model information by model_name"""
    all_models = AVAILABLE_MODELS + OLLAMA_MODELS
    return next((model for model in all_models if model.model_name == model_name), None)"

body: "def to_choice_tuple(self) -> Tuple[str, str, str]:\n        \"\"\"Convert to format needed for questionary choices\"\"\"\n        return (self.display_name, self.model_name, self.provider.value)"
docstring_or_comment: "Check if the model supports JSON mode"

body: "def has_json_mode(self) -> bool:
        """Check if the model supports JSON mode"""
        if self.is_deepseek() or self.is_gemini():
            return False
        # Only certain Ollama models support JSON mode
        if self.is_ollama():
            return "llama3" in self.model_name or "neural-chat" in self.model_name
        return True"

body: "def is_deepseek(self) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Check if the model is a DeepSeek model\"\"\"\n        return self.model_name.startswith(\"deepseek\")"

body: "def is_gemini(self) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Check if the model is a Gemini model\"\"\"\n        return self.model_name.startswith(\"gemini\")"
docstring_or_comment: "Check if the model is an Ollama model"
body: "def is_ollama(self) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Check if the model is an Ollama model\"\"\"\n        return self.provider == ModelProvider.OLLAMA"
